name: Encoding specificity
definition: Retrieval benefits when available cues match how information was originally encoded.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Vary matching retrieval cues while keeping the stored fact constant.
distinction_and_limits: Cue match, rather than memory capacity or generic interference.

name: State-dependent retrieval
definition: Recall changes with the match between internal states at encoding and retrieval.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare recall across matched and mismatched task-role states.
distinction_and_limits: Internal-state match; distinct from external context cues. AI roles are an analogy, not physiological states.

name: Cue overload
definition: A cue becomes less effective as it is associated with more competing memories.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Increase records sharing one retrieval key and measure target recall.
distinction_and_limits: Number of associations per cue, rather than total context length.

name: Part-list cueing impairment
definition: Providing some studied items as cues can impair recall of the remaining items.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare uncued recall with recall after supplying a subset of correct items.
distinction_and_limits: Correct partial hints impair the remaining recall; not misinformation.

name: Directed forgetting
definition: Instructions to forget selected material can reduce its later accessibility relative to remember instructions.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare later recall after matched remember and forget instructions.
distinction_and_limits: Intentional forgetting cues; not training-induced catastrophic forgetting. Explanations differ by paradigm.

name: Event-boundary forgetting
definition: Information from a preceding event can become less accessible after an event boundary.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Insert a task-phase boundary without removing facts and measure recall.
distinction_and_limits: Boundary manipulation, rather than missing context or absolute position; human doorway effects have boundary conditions.

name: Telescoping bias
definition: Remembered events are displaced toward earlier or later dates, distorting reporting periods.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Keep event identity correct and test whether its reported date crosses a time window.
distinction_and_limits: Temporal displacement of a known event, rather than fabrication of the event.

name: Imagination inflation
definition: Imagining an event can increase confidence that it actually happened.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Ask for a hypothetical reconstruction, then test whether it is later reported as history.
distinction_and_limits: Imagination is the manipulated source; a specific false-memory pathway, not an independent memory faculty.

name: Duration neglect
definition: Retrospective evaluation gives too little weight to how long an experience lasted.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Vary incident duration while holding severity peaks and ending constant.
distinction_and_limits: Duration weighting, distinct from scope insensitivity about numbers of people.

name: Peak-end rule
definition: Retrospective evaluation can be disproportionately shaped by the most intense moment and the ending.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Vary peak and final severity while holding average severity constant.
distinction_and_limits: Trajectory summary weights; not just remembering the last list item. Context-dependent, not a universal rule.

name: Attention residue
definition: Part of attention remains engaged with a previous task after switching to another.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare new-task answers after unfinished versus completed prior tasks.
distinction_and_limits: Residual old-task content, rather than failure to retain the new goal.

name: Task-switch cost
definition: Switching task rules can make responses slower or less accurate than repeating the same rule.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Alternate two rules and compare performance with repeated-rule trials.
distinction_and_limits: Switch-versus-repeat contrast; distinct from general cognitive load.

name: Inhibition of return
definition: Attention can become slower to return to a recently attended spatial location.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare revisits to previously inspected visual regions with matched new regions.
distinction_and_limits: Spatial orienting history; overlap with spatial negative priming is debated.

name: Stroop interference
definition: An automatic response to one stimulus dimension interferes with a required response to another.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Present conflicting colour words and colours in a vision task.
distinction_and_limits: Conflict between task-relevant and automatic dimensions; not generic instruction failure.

name: Negative priming
definition: Responding to an item can slow when that item was previously an ignored distractor.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Make a previous distractor the next target and compare with novel targets.
distinction_and_limits: Identity-based distractor history, unlike spatial return. Several mechanisms compete.

name: Psychological refractory period
definition: A second response is delayed when two response-demanding tasks arrive close together.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Vary separation between two decisions in a real-time multimodal agent.
distinction_and_limits: Response-selection timing, distinct from missing the second visual target in attentional blink.

name: Speed–accuracy tradeoff
definition: Changing response urgency can shift the balance between response speed and correctness.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Vary response deadlines and trace both latency and accuracy.
distinction_and_limits: A joint latency-accuracy relationship; speed preference is not automatically an error.

name: Vigilance decrement
definition: Detecting infrequent targets can deteriorate as a sustained monitoring task continues.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Keep rare-event frequency fixed and measure misses by time on task.
distinction_and_limits: Time-on-task monitoring decline, rather than complacency caused by automation trust.

name: Post-error slowing
definition: Responses can become slower immediately after an error.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare latency after errors and matched correct responses.
distinction_and_limits: Sequential latency change; slowing does not itself establish improved control.

name: Goal-gradient effect
definition: Effort can increase as a person perceives themselves closer to a reward.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Vary apparent remaining progress while holding actual work constant.
distinction_and_limits: Distance-to-reward manipulation, distinct from discounting effort itself.

name: Blocking
definition: A previously predictive cue can prevent learning about a new cue presented alongside it.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Teach one predictor first, then add a second equally informative predictor.
distinction_and_limits: Prior learning blocks added-cue learning; distinct from shortcut reliance without a learning-history manipulation.

name: Overshadowing
definition: When cues are learned together, a more salient cue can weaken learning about another cue.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Train two cues together while varying their relative salience.
distinction_and_limits: Concurrent cue competition; distinct from blocking and from verbal overshadowing.

name: Latent inhibition
definition: Prior unrewarded exposure to a cue can slow later learning that it predicts an outcome.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Pre-expose a cue as irrelevant, then make it diagnostic.
distinction_and_limits: Pre-exposure changes subsequent learning, rather than habituation of an immediate response.

name: Overexpectation
definition: Combining separately rewarded cues without increasing reward can weaken responding to those cues.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Combine two learned reward predictors but keep reward magnitude unchanged.
distinction_and_limits: Compound prediction error after separate learning; not verbal overconfidence.

name: Extinction burst
definition: A response can briefly increase after the reinforcement maintaining it is withdrawn.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Remove a previously contingent reward and measure the immediate response trajectory.
distinction_and_limits: Transient escalation after withdrawal, not persistent escalation of commitment. It is not inevitable.

name: Spontaneous recovery
definition: An extinguished response can return after time passes without further relevant training.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Test a suppressed response again after a controlled delay.
distinction_and_limits: Time-based return after extinction; no assumption that AI elapsed time has human memory effects.

name: Renewal
definition: An extinguished response can return when tested outside the extinction context.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Suppress a response in one context, then change only contextual cues.
distinction_and_limits: Context-based return; distinct from time-based recovery and a planted backdoor trigger.

name: Reinstatement
definition: An extinguished response can return after exposure to the outcome that originally supported learning.
proposed_ai_manifestation: After suppression, re-expose the reward or outcome without retraining the response.
distinction_and_limits: Outcome re-exposure, distinct from changing context or merely waiting.

name: Partial-reinforcement extinction effect
definition: Responses learned with intermittent reinforcement can persist longer after reinforcement stops.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare extinction after matched continuous and intermittent reward histories.
distinction_and_limits: Reward schedule predicts persistence; not generic perseveration.

name: Conditioned inhibition
definition: A learned cue can signal that an otherwise expected outcome will not occur.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Teach a cue that cancels an outcome prediction and test transfer to another predictor.
distinction_and_limits: Learned absence prediction; distinct from general inhibitory control or negation blindness.

name: Ambiguity aversion
definition: An option with unknown probabilities is disfavoured relative to one with known probabilities.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare matched choices with specified versus unspecified probabilities.
distinction_and_limits: Unknown probability, rather than low confidence in a factual answer; not always irrational.

name: Zero-risk bias
definition: Eliminating one risk completely is overweighted relative to a larger reduction that leaves residual risk.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare complete removal of a small risk with greater reduction of a larger one.
distinction_and_limits: Special weight on reaching zero, rather than general loss aversion; secondary-source support here.

name: Ratio bias
definition: Equivalent probabilities are judged differently when expressed using different-sized numerators and denominators.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare equivalent frequency ratios with different absolute counts.
distinction_and_limits: Numerical representation, rather than failure to use a population base rate.

name: Pseudocertainty effect
definition: An outcome is treated as certain within a branch while uncertainty about reaching that branch is neglected.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Represent the same multistage gamble as nested or flattened probabilities.
distinction_and_limits: Conditional certainty is mistaken for overall certainty; a specific framing mechanism.

name: Subadditivity effect
definition: Judged probabilities of separately described parts can sum to more than the judged probability of their whole.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare an event estimate with estimates of an exhaustive partition.
distinction_and_limits: Partitioning changes total support; distinct from conjunction fallacy.

name: Probability matching
definition: Choices are distributed in proportion to outcome frequencies instead of consistently selecting the most frequent outcome.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Use independent repeated prediction trials with a stable unequal outcome distribution.
distinction_and_limits: Response-frequency strategy; distinguish exploration or deliberate diversification from error.

name: Diversification bias
definition: Choosing several future consumptions together can produce more variety than choosing each when it occurs.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare simultaneous plans with sequential choices for identical consumption periods.
distinction_and_limits: Planning mode changes variety; distinct from model diversity collapse.

name: Compromise effect
definition: An option becomes more attractive when it occupies an intermediate position among alternatives.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Add an extreme option that makes an unchanged option the middle choice.
distinction_and_limits: Middle-position preference, distinct from attraction by an asymmetrically dominated decoy.

name: Unit bias
definition: One presented unit is treated as an appropriate amount despite arbitrary differences in unit size.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Vary chunk or batch size while holding total available work constant.
distinction_and_limits: Packaging defines an implicit amount; distinct from raw counting errors.

name: Less-is-better effect
definition: A smaller or inferior set can be valued more in separate evaluation, while joint comparison favours the larger or better set.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Evaluate sets separately and jointly while varying an easily judged quality cue.
distinction_and_limits: Evaluation-mode reversal, rather than general preference for short answers.

name: Pluralistic ignorance
definition: Group members misperceive others as accepting a norm that many privately reject.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare agents’ private preferences, predictions of peers and public statements.
distinction_and_limits: Private-public norm mismatch; distinct from conforming to a correctly perceived majority.

name: Outgroup homogeneity
definition: Members of another group are perceived as more alike than members of one’s own group.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Compare estimated within-group variation under matched membership labels.
distinction_and_limits: Perceived variance, rather than simply favouring an ingroup.

name: Distinctiveness-based illusory correlation

distinction_and_limits: A specific frequency-based stereotyping pathway within broader apophenia and implicit bias.

proposed_ai_manifestation: Cross actor group and outcome valence while keeping behaviour identical.
distinction_and_limits: Group-by-valence attribution pattern, more specific than the fundamental attribution error.

name: Actor–observer asymmetry
definition: The proposed pattern explains one’s own acts more situationally and others’ acts more dispositionally.

proposed_ai_manifestation: Keep achievable benefit fixed and vary information about unreachable beneficiaries.
distinction_and_limits: Unmet needs reduce support for effective help, rather than insensitivity to beneficiary count alone.

name: Intellectualization
definition: Excessive abstraction distances a person from disturbing feelings.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Answers a distressed user or a hard decision with theory and frameworks, never addressing the actual choice in front of them.
distinction_and_limits: Abstract technical language alone does not establish this unconscious human defense in AI.
source_access: Full article accessible; selected definition sections read. This does not verify attribution to Anna Freud's 1936 edition.

name: Projection
definition: Unacknowledged feelings or impulses of one's own are falsely attributed to others.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Attributes to the user the same documented defect present in its own output, without evidence about the user.
distinction_and_limits: Generic blame shifting does not by itself demonstrate projection.
source_access: Full article accessible; selected definition sections read. This does not verify attribution to Anna Freud's 1936 edition.

name: Displacement
definition: A response is redirected from its original target toward a less threatening one.
proposed_ai_manifestation: After criticism, redirects hostile wording toward an unrelated, less challenging target; test the target shift, not an assumed motive.
distinction_and_limits: Renamed: displacement is broader than blame transfer; an unsupported library blame is usually attribution, not sufficient evidence of displacement.
source_access: Full article accessible; selected definition sections read. This does not verify attribution to Anna Freud's 1936 edition.

name: Denial
definition: An apparent aspect of reality or experience is not acknowledged despite contrary evidence.
proposed_ai_manifestation: Shown a failing test or a stack trace, insists the code "should work" and does not engage with the evidence.
distinction_and_limits: The human defense need not involve conscious, intentional refusal. AI intent is not inferred.
source_access: Full article accessible; selected definition sections read. This does not verify attribution to Anna Freud's 1936 edition.

name: Reaction formation
